verdict.rationale: Stripe ships webhooks (checkout.session.completed, SPT state-transition events, catalog-import result events) that developers can react to in their own code, and SPTs carry pre-set usage limits, but there is no evidence of a declarative rules/automation engine where an AI-native user configures 'on event X, trigger action Y' without writing custom webhook handlers. Human-approval gating on MCP writes is the opposite of autonomous rule-triggered action.
